toc.note_zh: 全书由七章与一则后记组成，章题据通行版式；页码与具体小节未逐页核对。
toc.note_en: Seven chapters and a postscript, chapter titles following the common edition; page numbers and subsections not checked page by page.

items: Disjuncture and Difference in the Global Cultural Economy
Global Ethnoscapes: Notes and Queries for a Transnational Anthropology
Playing with Modernity: The Decolonization of Indian Cricket

excerpts.trans_zh: 全球文化流动由五个维度构成：族群景观、媒体景观、技术景观、金融景观与意识形态景观；它们彼此断裂，因此全球化不是同质化。
excerpts.trans_en: Global cultural flow has five dimensions — ethnoscapes, mediascapes, technoscapes, financescapes and ideoscapes — which are disjunctive, so globalisation is not homogenisation.

excerpts.paraphrase: 地方性命题（非逐字原文）
excerpts.trans_zh: 地方性不是自然给定的背景，而是在邻里、仪式与日常实践中被不断生产出来的。
excerpts.trans_en: Locality is not a naturally given backdrop but is continually produced in neighbourhood, ritual and everyday practice.

excerpts.trans_zh: 电子媒体让「想象」成为日常社会实践：人们借远方的图像来设计自己的生活，移民与民族主义都由此获得素材。
excerpts.trans_en: Electronic media make imagination an everyday social practice: people design their lives with images from elsewhere, and both migration and nationalism draw on them.

plot_acts.zh: Appadurai 提出五种「景观」（族群、媒体、技术、金融、意识形态），它们的流动速度与方向彼此不同，因此全球化产生的是差异而非同质。
plot_acts.en: Appadurai proposes five scapes — ethnic, media, techno, finance, ideo — whose flows move at different speeds and directions, so globalisation produces difference rather than sameness.

brief.main: 全球化是一组错位的流动，而不是一套统一的输出。
brief.flow: 从五个维度，到错位关系，再到文化后果。
brief.names: 移民、媒体、资本、国家意识形态。
brief.main_en: Globalisation is a set of disjunctive flows, not one uniform export.
brief.flow_en: From the five dimensions to their disjunction to cultural consequence.

plot_acts.zh: 第二组章讨论消费如何重排时间感：广告、商品与媒体让不同历史节奏并置，消费成为参与现代性的方式。
plot_acts.en: The second group asks how consumption rearranges the sense of time: advertising, commodities and media juxtapose different historical rhythms, and consumption becomes a way of participating in modernity.

brief.main: 买东西也是一种历史实践。
brief.flow: 从商品，到时间感，再到历史叙事。
brief.link: 把经济实践接到文化时间。
brief.main_en: Shopping is also a historical practice.
brief.flow_en: From commodities to the sense of time to historical narrative.
brief.link_en: Connects economic practice to cultural time.

plot_acts.zh: 中段以印度板球、殖民时期的数字治理与「原始主义之后」为例，展示地方如何挪用全球形式，把它们变成民族与社群政治的场域。
plot_acts.en: Middle chapters use Indian cricket, colonial number governance and 'life after primordialism' to show how localities appropriate global forms and turn them into sites of national and communal politics.

brief.main: 全球形式一旦落地，就被改写成地方政治。
brief.flow: 从殖民引入，到民族化，再到社群冲突。
brief.names: 板球、殖民统计、社群政党。
brief.link: 用具体案例检验景观理论。
brief.main_en: Once global forms land, they are rewritten as local politics.
brief.flow_en: From colonial introduction to nationalisation to communal conflict.
brief.link_en: Tests scape theory on concrete cases.

plot_acts.zh: 结论提出「地方性的生产」：地方不是全球的对立面，而是需要持续被做出来的成就；邻里的仪式与日常实践就是这种生产。
plot_acts.en: The conclusion proposes 'the production of locality': locality is not the opposite of the global but an achievement that must be continually made, in neighbourhood ritual and everyday practice.

brief.main: 地方性是一种需要维护的成就。
brief.flow: 从仪式，到邻里，再到全球压力下的脆弱性。
brief.link: 把全书收束为一种地方性理论。
brief.main_en: Locality is an achievement requiring maintenance.
brief.flow_en: From ritual to neighbourhood to vulnerability under global pressure.
brief.link_en: Gathers the book into a theory of locality.

plot_acts.title_zh: de Groot 的问题与 Gobet 的接手
plot_acts.zh: 全书以跨代对话展开：de Groot 在 1940 年代问「棋手在看什么」，Gobet 用实验与模型重新回答，并把「知觉」而非「搜索」放在专长的中心。
plot_acts.en: The book unfolds as a transgenerational dialogue: de Groot asked in the 1940s what players look at, and Gobet answers again with experiments and models, placing perception rather than search at the centre of expertise.

brief.main: 专长不是想得更多，而是看得不同。
brief.flow: 从经典问题，到实验方法，再到理论重述。
brief.link: 为后续的组块与模板理论奠基。
brief.main_en: Expertise is not thinking more but seeing differently.
brief.flow_en: From the classic question to experimental method to theoretical restatement.
brief.link_en: Grounds the later chunking and template theory.

plot_acts.zh: 核心证据：专家在极短时间内就能把握局面要点，眼动与回忆实验显示他们看到的不是棋子，而是有意义的棋型。
plot_acts.en: The core evidence: experts grasp the essentials of a position in a fraction of a second, and eye-movement and recall experiments show they see meaningful patterns rather than pieces.

brief.main: 「一眼看出」是可以被实验测量的。
brief.flow: 从短暂呈现，到回忆成绩，再到眼动轨迹。
brief.link: 把直觉从神秘变成机制。
brief.main_en: 'Seeing at a glance' can be measured experimentally.
brief.flow_en: From brief presentation to recall scores to eye movements.
brief.link_en: Turns intuition from mystery into mechanism.

plot_acts.zh: 理论部分：专家的记忆以「组块」为单位，并在长期训练中形成更大的「模板」，这解释了为何专家记忆真实棋局远胜随机棋局。
plot_acts.en: The theory: expert memory works in chunks and, through long training, in larger templates, which explains why experts recall real positions far better than random ones.

brief.main: 记忆的单位是意义，而不是元素。
brief.flow: 从组块，到模板，再到专家优势的边界。
brief.link: 把知觉与记忆统一为一个架构。
brief.main_en: The unit of memory is meaning, not elements.
brief.flow_en: From chunks to templates to the limits of expert advantage.
brief.link_en: Unifies perception and memory in one architecture.

plot_acts.zh: 结论承认：知觉优势只在熟悉的局面中有效，随机局面会抹平专家与新手差距；这也为后来的「模板」修正与技能迁移研究留下入口。
plot_acts.en: The conclusion concedes that perceptual advantage works only in familiar positions and vanishes in random ones, opening the way for later template revisions and transfer research.

brief.main: 专长有边界，边界本身就是证据。
brief.flow: 从随机局面，到理论修正，再到迁移问题。
brief.link: 把本书接到 2000 年代后的专长研究。
brief.main_en: Expertise has boundaries, and the boundaries are themselves evidence.
brief.flow_en: From random positions to theoretical revision to the problem of transfer.
brief.link_en: Connects the book to expertise research after 2000.

plot_acts.title_zh: 为什么不能只看国际象棋
plot_acts.zh: Gobet 等主张：国际象棋只是棋盘游戏的一种，若不比较围棋、将棋、西洋跳棋，就无法判断哪些认知机制是普适的。
plot_acts.en: Gobet and colleagues argue chess is only one board game; without comparing go, shogi and draughts, we cannot tell which cognitive mechanisms are general.

brief.main: 单一游戏的研究，无法区分「棋类」与「国际象棋」。
brief.flow: 从国际象棋中心，到跨游戏比较，再到机制检验。
brief.names: 国际象棋、围棋、将棋、跳棋。
brief.main_en: A single game cannot separate 'board games' from 'chess'.
brief.flow_en: From chess-centrism to cross-game comparison to testing mechanisms.

plot_acts.zh: 比较显示：组块与模板机制在多种棋类中都成立，但游戏规则（如将棋的持驹）会改变记忆与搜索的具体形态。
plot_acts.en: Comparison shows chunking and templates hold across games, but rules — such as shogi's drops — change the specific shape of memory and search.

brief.main: 普遍机制在具体规则下长出不同形态。
brief.flow: 从组块，到规则差异，再到行为后果。
brief.names: 将棋持驹、围棋布局、跳棋残局。
brief.link: 把认知普遍性与文化特殊性接合。
brief.main_en: Universal mechanisms take different shapes under specific rules.
brief.flow_en: From chunking to rule differences to behavioural consequences.
brief.names_en: Shogi drops, go openings, draughts endgames.
brief.link_en: Joins cognitive universals to cultural specificity.

plot_acts.zh: 后段讨论训练如何塑造专长、技能能否迁移，以及棋类在不同文化中的位置：棋不只是认知任务，也是制度与教养的载体。
plot_acts.en: Later chapters discuss how training shapes expertise, whether skill transfers, and the place of board games in different cultures: games are institutions and forms of upbringing, not only cognitive tasks.

brief.main: 棋艺是练出来的，也是被文化安排的。
brief.flow: 从训练，到迁移，再到文化制度。
brief.sources: 训练研究与跨文化材料。
brief.link: 把认知科学接回社会语境。
brief.main_en: Skill is trained, and it is also arranged by culture.
brief.flow_en: From training to transfer to cultural institutions.
brief.link_en: Reconnects cognitive science to social context.

plot_acts.zh: de Groot 把棋手请进实验室，让他们边想边说；他要研究的不是棋艺，而是「选择」这一思维过程本身。
plot_acts.en: De Groot brought players into the laboratory to think aloud; what he studied was not chess skill but the thought process of choice itself.

brief.main: 要研究思维，就要让它说出来。
brief.flow: 从问题设定，到方法设计，再到记录分析。
brief.link: 开创了专家研究的口述方法。
brief.main_en: To study thinking, make it speak.
brief.flow_en: From framing the question to designing the method to analysing protocols.
brief.link_en: Founds the verbal-report method in expertise research.

plot_acts.zh: 最重要的发现：高手并不计算更多着法，而是在最初几秒就识别出少数「好着法」，随后才做验证；新手则平均分配注意力。
plot_acts.en: The key finding: masters do not calculate more moves but recognise a few good ones in the first seconds and then verify; novices distribute attention evenly.

brief.main: 选择的第一步是识别，不是计算。
brief.flow: 从第一印象，到候选着法，再到验证。
brief.link: 为后来的知觉专长理论提供原始证据。
brief.main_en: The first step of choice is recognition, not calculation.
brief.flow_en: From first impression to candidate moves to verification.
brief.link_en: Supplies the original evidence for later perceptual expertise theory.

plot_acts.title_zh: 理论化：知觉、启发法与阶段
plot_acts.zh: de Groot 提出阶段模型：定向、探索、调查、验证；并以「启发法」解释专家如何在信息不足时仍能快速判断。
plot_acts.en: De Groot proposes a phase model — orientation, exploration, investigation, verification — and uses heuristics to explain how experts judge quickly on incomplete information.

brief.main: 决策是有阶段的，而非一次性计算。
brief.flow: 从阶段划分，到启发法，再到理论边界。
brief.link: 把实验发现转成可检验的模型。
brief.main_en: Decision has phases rather than being one act of calculation.
brief.flow_en: From phases to heuristics to theoretical limits.
brief.link_en: Turns findings into a testable model.

plot_acts.title_zh: 遗产：从棋桌到认知科学
plot_acts.title_en: Legacy: from the chessboard to cognitive science
plot_acts.zh: 结论把棋类定位为「思维的自然实验室」：它可控制、可测量、可重复，因此成为二十世纪认知科学的原型任务。
plot_acts.en: The conclusion positions chess as a natural laboratory of thought: controllable, measurable and repeatable, it became a prototype task for twentieth-century cognitive science.

brief.main: 棋不是隐喻，而是实验装置。
brief.flow: 从棋局，到实验范式，再到学科影响。
brief.names: 认知科学、人工智能、心理学。
brief.link: 解释本书为何被反复引用。
brief.main_en: Chess is not a metaphor but an experimental apparatus.
brief.flow_en: From positions to experimental paradigm to disciplinary influence.
brief.link_en: Explains why the book is so often cited.
